items.title: TraceGuard: Structured Multi-Dimensional Monitoring as a Collusion-Resistant Control Protocol
items.target_h2: 从 Linear Trace 到 Root-cause Graph
items.target_ref: books/part-06-ai-infrastructure/69-trace.md#L105 (H2: 从 Linear Trace 到 Root-cause Graph)
adjacent_refs: books/part-06-ai-infrastructure/68-logging.md#L86 (H2: 从错误字符串到决策证据)
items.mechanism_delta: TraceGuard 将 goal alignment、constraint adherence、reasoning coherence、safety awareness 与 action-trace consistency 分开观测，并组合独立 LLM/heuristic signals；monitoring owner 保存各维证据、observer identity、分歧和最终 gate，而非只提交一个不可审计 scalar。
items.changed_constraint: 单一 monitor score 在诚实 agent 与低相关风险下便于部署；当 monitor 与 agent 可能同源或串谋、攻击只在 reasoning/action trace 中显现时，单分数会丢失职责分离与不一致证据。
items.tradeoffs_failure_fallback: 收益是作者 519 样本协议中的 attack/honest separation 与 separation-of-duties 路径；代价是多观察者调用、相关失败和阈值校准。观察者仍可能共享盲点，异常时回退最小权限、人工升级与隔离执行，论文样本不证明开放生产环境安全率。
items.evidence_boundary: `TraceGuard: Structured Multi-Dimensional Monitoring as a Collusion-Resistant Control Protocol` 只证明 exact-v1 的公开模型、数据、硬件和 workload；evaluation evidence 为：Our results on 519 samples (279 honest, 240 attack) show that: (1) the hybrid approach achieves clear attack-honest separation (attack mean 0.616 vs. 0% for single-score untrusted monitoring; (3) goal alignment and constraint adherence are the most discriminative dimensions; and (4) a separation-of-duties variant splitting dimensions across trusted and untrusted models achieves 100% safety while preventing any single model from seeing the full evaluation. 未披露生产 SLO、多租户、跨硬件或长期运行结果时，不得外推。
items.suggested_insertion: 在 `从 Linear Trace 到 Root-cause Graph` 的演进主线内、章末小结与 Review notes 前整合。

items.title: Ledger-State Stigmergy: A Formal Framework for Indirect Coordination Grounded in Distributed Ledger State
adjacent_refs: books/part-07-agent/81-workflow.md#L223 (H2: Evaluator-Driven Search：可执行反馈如何变成 Workflow)
items.mechanism_delta: Ledger-State Stigmergy 让参与者通过追加并观察 durable ledger state 间接协调；ledger/schema/commit owner 定义可见状态、更新顺序与因果关系，message 只是一种输入而不是最终事实 owner。
items.changed_constraint: 多智能体协调通常把 message 当作共享事实；低并发和可信参与者下足够直接，但消息丢失、重放、并发写入或成员异步观察后，通信记录不再等同于一致的共享状态。
items.tradeoffs_failure_fallback: 收益是把间接协调锚定到可追溯状态；代价是一致性延迟、ledger 成本、schema 演进和错误状态的持久传播。无需审计/跨域协作时仍可用轻量消息，ledger 不可用或共识成本过高时应回退单 owner workflow。该 exact-v1 主要给出形式框架，不证明生产吞吐或容错上界。
items.evidence_boundary: `Ledger-State Stigmergy: A Formal Framework for Indirect Coordination Grounded in Distributed Ledger State` 只证明 exact-v1 的公开模型、数据、硬件和 workload；evaluation evidence 为：Not Disclosed — 摘要未给出足以跨 workload 复算的完整 evaluation matrix；正文实验仍只按 exact-v1 范围引用。 未披露生产 SLO、多租户、跨硬件或长期运行结果时，不得外推。
items.suggested_insertion: 在 `Message 不是 State` 的演进主线内、章末小结与 Review notes 前整合。

items.title: Causality Laundering: Denial-Feedback Leakage in Tool-Calling LLM Agents
items.mechanism_delta: ARM 在每次 tool invocation 前查询包含调用、返回字段、provenance 与 denied action 的因果图，并让 reference monitor 同时拥有授权判定与 denial-feedback disclosure policy；拒绝不再只是布尔结果，而是受控观察。
items.changed_constraint: 工具安全策略通常把 denied action 当作安全终点并把拒绝原因原样返回；在单步调用中便于调试，但多步 agent 可把允许/拒绝及字段级差异当作 oracle，逐步推断受保护的因果与 provenance。
items.tradeoffs_failure_fallback: 收益是在论文三个攻击场景中阻断 causality laundering、transitive taint 与 mixed-provenance misuse，报告 policy evaluation 为亚毫秒；代价是细粒度 taint graph、反馈降级与误拒绝。覆盖外工具语义、隐式信道或错误 provenance 仍可能绕过，异常时回退最小反馈、人工审批和隔离执行。
items.evidence_boundary: `Causality Laundering: Denial-Feedback Leakage in Tool-Calling LLM Agents` 只证明 exact-v1 的公开模型、数据、硬件和 workload；evaluation evidence 为：In a controlled evaluation on three representative attack scenarios, ARM blocks causality laundering, transitive taint propagation, and mixed-provenance field misuse that a flat provenance baseline misses, while adding sub-millisecond policy evaluation overhead. These results suggest that denial-aware causal provenance is a useful abstraction for securing tool-calling agent systems. 未披露生产 SLO、多租户、跨硬件或长期运行结果时，不得外推。
items.suggested_insertion: 在 `Availability 与 Abuse` 的演进主线内、章末小结与 Review notes 前整合。

items.title: APPA: Adaptive Preference Pluralistic Alignment for Fair Federated RLHF of LLMs
items.target_h2: Preference data 的难点不只是数量
items.target_ref: books/part-04-training-system/31-rlhf.md#L115 (H2: Preference data 的难点不只是数量)
adjacent_refs: books/part-04-training-system/30-lora.md#L223 (H2: Merge 与动态 Adapter 是两种资产策略)
books/part-04-training-system/32-ppo.md#L321 (H2: PPO 没有解决 Reward correctness)
items.mechanism_delta: APPA 根据各 group 的历史 alignment reward 动态重加权 federated PPO 更新；聚合 owner 保存 group identity、历史 reward、权重与 fairness/alignment decision，使 pluralistic preference state 不被压成单一 reward。
items.changed_constraint: Federated RLHF 以平均 group reward 聚合偏好，在群体同质且数据可集中比较时简单；群体对齐程度不同且 raw preference 不可共享时，平均会让多数/高分群体持续主导更新。
items.tradeoffs_failure_fallback: 收益是在 GLOBALQA/OQA、三类公开模型设置中提高 worst-group alignment，同时多数配置保持较高 overall alignment；代价是历史信号漂移、group 定义与 fairness/utility 权衡。群体标签失真或权重振荡时回退受限平均/最小群体约束并人工复核，结果不外推到未测人群与偏好协议。
items.evidence_boundary: `APPA: Adaptive Preference Pluralistic Alignment for Fair Federated RLHF of LLMs` 只证明 exact-v1 的公开模型、数据、硬件和 workload；evaluation evidence 为：Integrated into a proximal policy optimization (PPO) based FedRLHF pipeline and evaluated on GLOBALQA and OQA across three model families (Gemma 2 2B, Llama 3.2 3B, Qwen3 0.6B), APPA achieves strong fairness alignment trade offs, improving worst group alignment by up to 28% over average aggregation while maintaining higher overall alignment than min aggregation across most configurations. 未披露生产 SLO、多租户、跨硬件或长期运行结果时，不得外推。
items.suggested_insertion: 在 `Preference data 的难点不只是数量` 的演进主线内、章末小结与 Review notes 前整合。
